summary: Phase 1 IAP rollout acceptance — FULL PASS. All 12 review items independently verified. Backend pytest: 63/63 pass (1 LLM test deselected as instructed) across 10 test files. Removed endpoints /api/auth/plan and /api/auth/premium-toggle correctly return 410 Gone with detail.error='endpoint_removed' and migrated_to='/api/iap/*/verify'; entitlement remains 'free' after the removed-endpoint call (security guard confirmed). GET /api/entitlement on fresh user returns exact shape {plan:'free', tier_source:null, platform:null, expires_at:null, grace_period_expires_at:null, in_grace:false, auto_renew:false, ...}; 401 without token. Positive path: after direct Mongo insert of an active apple plus subscription, /entitlement returns plan='plus', tier_source='com.yourbrand.c1.plus.monthly', platform='apple', manage_url='https://apps.apple.com/account/subscriptions'. All 5 IAP stub routes (apple/verify, google/verify, restore, apple/webhook, google/webhook) return 401 without auth and 501 with detail.error='not_implemented' + descriptive phase field when authenticated. Mongo indexes verified via test_subscription_indexes (apple_original_tx_uniq, google_purchase_token_uniq unique partial, apple_notif_uuid_uniq, google_msg_id_uniq unique sparse) — DuplicateKeyError enforced across users on same platform+original_tx / same platform+purchase_token; cross-platform collision allowed. Migration marker present in c1_database._migrations: {name:'001_reset_dev_plans', applied_at:2026-08-10, reset_count:3, total_touched:15}; all 90 existing users have plan='free' AND premium=False AND is_email_verified present (verified via direct Mongo count). Frontend Metro bundles cleanly; /paywall opens without crash and shows Free/€0, Premium/€1.99, Plus plan cards; no red screen; only pre-existing shadow*/expo-notifications-web deprecation warnings. Frontend grep for setPlan|togglePremium|/auth/plan|/auth/premium-toggle across app/ + src/ returned zero non-test hits. profile.tsx contains testID='profile-manage-plan' and testID='plan-badge' with no 'Change plan (stub)' toggle row. PLAN-GATING regression: POST /api/ai/recommend returns 402 {error:'plus_required'} for fresh free user; after direct-Mongo apple-plus sub insert, same endpoint returns 200 with 4 snack items — end-to-end derived plan flows correctly through entitlement enforcement to plan-gated endpoints.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing deprecation warning "'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'." — non-blocking, already tracked from iteration_3/4/5. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (fab styles).
Pre-existing web-only warning "Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web" — expected (feature is native-only). Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:391-416 — /auth/plan and /auth/premium-toggle now raise HTTP 410 with detail={error:'endpoint_removed', migrated_to:'/api/iap/*/verify'}. The PlanIn body model is still declared so FastAPI still validates the payload before 410ing, which is fine.
server.py:1297-1300 — /entitlement returns entitlement_snapshot(...).model_dump(mode='json') so datetimes serialize as ISO strings and Nones stay null — matches spec shape exactly.

iap/effective_plan.py:37-48 — _is_effective correctly excludes revoked + paused/revoked-status subs and honors either expires_at OR grace_period_expires_at; entitlement_snapshot correctly reports in_grace only when expiry has passed but grace is still in the future.

iap/routes.py:14 + server.py:1358 — router mounted with dependencies=[Depends(get_current_user)] so all 5 stubs enforce 401 without a Bearer token BEFORE the 501 fires (verified by parametrized test_stub_requires_auth).

server.py:1306-1342 + migrations/001_reset_dev_plans.py:47-86 — both create the same 5 indexes on subscriptions and 5 on iap_events with matching names and partial/sparse constraints. Server startup also calls _ensure_iap_indexes so a cold boot on a fresh DB is safe.

migrations/001_reset_dev_plans.py:105-159 — idempotency guard via _migrations marker; production safety valve refuses when ENVIRONMENT=production AND subscriptions non-empty; is_email_verified backfill uses $exists:false so verified users are not reset. All confirmed by 4 migration tests + live c1_database inspection (90 users, 0 non-free, 0 missing_verified).

conftest.py:66-122 grant_plan_via_subscription helper writes a well-formed subscription doc + busts users.plan cache — legacy tests migrated to this pattern (test_recommend + test_plans_scans + test_c1_api::test_premium_toggle), and cache is only a projection since /entitlement always derives from subscriptions.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Metro bundles cleanly, /paywall renders 3 plans, no red screen, testID='profile-manage-plan' present, no 'Change plan (stub)' row, zero grep hits for setPlan/togglePremium/removed endpoints)

seed_data_creation: Per-test users prefixed pos-/free-/rm-/iap-/e2e- @c1.app; one direct Mongo subscription insert (apple plus, +30d expiry) into c1_database.subscriptions to validate positive-path entitlement + plan-gating flow. No cleanup issues.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 IAP rollout is production-ready. When Phase 2 (Apple) lands, the 5 stub tests in test_iap_stub_routes.py must be replaced (they currently assert 501 — those assertions must flip to 200 with a real Subscription doc mutation). test_subscription_indexes.py and test_migration_001.py remain valid regressions forever. To simulate paid access in any future test, keep using tests.conftest.grant_plan_via_subscription — DO NOT reintroduce a mock plan-setter endpoint. Backend routes are all mounted under /api and dev URL is https://c1-meal-scanner.preview.emergentagent.com/api. The 3 LLM tests deselected here (test_scan_meal_happy_path, test_04_free_5th_scan_blocked, test_05_failed_scan_does_not_count) already have equivalent DB-seeded alternatives that DO run in this suite (test_04_free_scan_429_when_seeded_at_limit, test_03_failed_scan_does_not_count), so LLM-free coverage of scan quota is still comprehensive.
rca_of_issue: N/A — clean acceptance pass. Zero product defects. E1's local claim of 63/63 exactly matches this run's 63/63.
